data.narrative:
SpaceForest is a publicly listed Space & Aerospace company (via GPW listing) founded by Robert Magiera, Andrzej Magiera, and Jerzy Michalski, having raised capital through IPO and ESA funding. The broader Space & Aerospace sector contains 13 comparable companies—5 public (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, ICEYE, Sierra Space, and Planet Labs.

Two standard valuation triangulation methods could not be applied in this analysis. Peer-median analysis is inapplicable due to insufficient narrow peer data: while 14 same-sector companies exist, none satisfy simultaneous filters for stage, adjacency, and valuation tier—a minimum of 3 datapoints is required to establish median multiples. Public-comp anchoring using the Space & Aerospace sector price-to-sales median of 27.4x across the 6 public tickers cannot proceed without SpaceForest's disclosed revenue, which remains unavailable on file as is typical for private companies.

Without executable valuation methods supported by the available data, no quantitative range can be defensibly derived. A credible valuation would require either: disclosure of SpaceForest's revenue to enable P/S anchoring; identification of 3+ directly comparable peers at matching stage and valuation tier; or alternative inputs such as recent secondary transaction data, DCF assumptions, or investor round terms. Current data insufficiency precludes triangulated valuation output.
